name: ofdh5-monorepo

scripts.build: pnpm --filter ofdh5 build && pnpm --filter ofdh5-vue2 build
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:vue2 && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.release: pnpm --filter ofdh5 publish --no-git-checks --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ && pnpm --filter ofdh5-vue2 publish --no-git-checks --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/

description: OFD（GB/T 33190-2016）文档预览库：纯前端解析 + Canvas 渲染，API 与 pdfh5 对齐，适配移动端手势与 Vue 2
